desc:
🃏 Collect Legendary Cards & Dominate the Court! 🏀

🎉 NEXT CODE AT 9500 LIKES! CHECK OUR GROUP SHOUT ON HOW TO FIND CODES! 🎉

Build your dream lineup by rolling hundreds of unique basketball cards, then step onto the court to challenge other players in fast-paced 1v1 matches. Sell your duplicates, climb the ranks, and prove you're the best!

🎮 How to Play:

🔄 Click "Roll" to unlock over 100+ collectible cards

💰 Sell duplicates for in-game cash to roll even more

🏀 Compete in real-time 1v1 basketball matches with your lineup

🍀 Roblox Premium users get a Luck Boost when rolling!

🎯 Tags: Basketball, Card Game, PvP, Shooter, Competitive, Sports, Basketball RNG

⚠️ Disclaimer: This game features fictional and stylized basketball characters created by us. No NBA-affiliated content is used. This game is not sponsored or endorsed by the NBA or any of its teams.

✅ All cards have been made from scratch with AI prompts explaining player likeness / features. No 3rd party images used.
